t: What is Alternative Fuel Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR)?
s: April 27, 2025 - The Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation is included in the Fit for 55 package—part of the broader European Green Deal, which sets emissions goals for 2050. Fit for 55 outlines policies aimed at achieving a 55% reduction in carbon emissions by 2030. AFIR specifically targets public EV charging across the EU by setting mandatory infrastructure objectives for each member state.
